Class Json5FormatterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5FormatterBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogBuilder<Json5FormatterBuilder, LogFormatter>
public final class Json5FormatterBuilder extends Object implements LogBuilder<Json5FormatterBuilder, LogFormatter>
Builder to create LogFormatter. Formats each event as a JSON5 (or JSON) object, one line unless pretty printed in full, for switching an application to structured logging without adding a module, for example: {time:"2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z",level:"INFO" ,logger:"com.example.App",thread:"main",msg:"hello world",requestId:"42"}.

The fields use logfmt's names: time (UTC instant with milliseconds), level, logger, thread, msg, and for a throwable error (its toString()) and stacktrace. Every value, key values included, is a string, or null for a key value without one. For a specific schema (ECS, GELF, Logstash) and more options use the rainbowgum-json module.

With JSON5, values can be colored like the TTLL formatter, and by default the level is padded after its closing quote so the value stays the level name: level:"INFO" ,logger:.... With JSON the color, theme, and pretty print are ignored, so the output stays plain JSON.

"logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.theme" String (converted) false null JSON5 only, which colors, see TTLL.ColorTheme.
